content: À kwakita kùrcau abǝshe a Shekem
Jesǝwa ram atau mala Isǝrayila kat a Shekem sǝ tunǝ aɓwana-mǝgule, andǝ amúrû, andǝ amǝ'ɓashi, andǝ amǝ'sàrǝ̀ban mala Isǝrayila. Sǝ à yinǝ ɓamuria aɓadǝm Yahweh.

Sǝ Jesǝwa banggi aɓwe kat ama, <<Yahweh, Ɓakuli mala Isǝrayila bang ama, <A pwarian ngga, aká-wun do a nkaring Yiufǝretis, sǝ à kpata aɓea aɓakuli. Mwashat atà amǝno yì aká-wun ngga nda Tera tár a Ibǝrayim andǝ Naho.
Pǝlǝa ǝn twal kà wun Ibǝrayim a nkaring Mùr Yiufǝretis sǝ ǝn gingnǝi aɓa nzali Kan'ana puppup, sǝ ǝn tsǝk amǝkè làkkì pas. Ən pe wi Ishaku.
Sǝ mala Ishaku ka, ǝn pe wi Yakupu andǝ Isǝwa. Sǝ ǝn pe Isǝwa nzali múr-nkono Seyir ɓǝ̀ duk girkuma male, sǝama Yakupu andǝ amuni ka, à o a Masar.
<< <Pǝlǝa ǝn túr Musa andǝ Haruna, sǝ ǝn yinǝ gìr'mur'mwana amúr Masar nǝ gir mǝnana ǝn pê aɓalǝi ka, sǝ nǝnzǝ́mò ka ǝn pusǝ wun, wu purî ɓalǝi.
Lang ǝn pusǝ aká wun, à purî Masar ka, à yi bik Nggeamùr Nzuno. Sǝ amǝ Masar pǝrta aká-wun nǝ awaru-pǝr andǝ amǝ'pǝ̀r, aban ká a Nggeamùr Nzuno.

Sǝ lang à ɓua abanam Mim Yahweh ka, ǝn tsǝk pǝndǝa anrea andǝ amǝ Masar. Ən tsǝk nggeamùr eau amúr amǝ Masar, sǝ gìr amúrià; wu sǝni nǝ mǝsǝ wun yì gìr mǝnana ǝn pe a Masar ka. Sǝ wu do a ɓabondo banì sauwa.
<< <Pǝlǝa ǝn yinǝ wun a nzali mala amǝ'Amor, mǝnana à do a ɓè nkaring mala Jodan ngga. À munǝ arǝ wun, sǝ ǝn tasǝia a ɓabù wun, sǝ wu ak nzali malea pǝlǝ girkuma ma'wun.
Pǝlǝa Balak muna-ɓwabura mala Zippor, murǝm mala Mowap, loasǝ munǝo arǝ Isǝrayila. Sǝ túrban à tunǝ Bil'am muna-ɓwabura mala Beyo acemǝnana ɓǝ̀ sú wun ngga,
sǝama ǝn kwakikiram arǝ Bil'am ɗàng. Yale yì ka tsǝka wun bù. Nda ǝn amsǝ wun a ɓabuì.

<< <Sǝ wu yàlî Jodan, wu yiu a Jeriko, sǝ aburana mala Jeriko munǝ arǝ wun, sǝ anggo gbal amǝ'Amor, andǝ amǝ'Periz, andǝ amǝ'Kan'ana, andǝ amǝ'Hitti, andǝ amǝ'Girgash, andǝ amǝ'Hivi, andǝ amǝ'Jebus. Sǝ ǝn tasǝia a ɓabù wun.
Aɓa ká ma'wun ngga, ǝn tasǝ amǝ'ta-nta a ɓadǝm wun mǝnana à pǝr amurǝma ɓari mala amǝ'Amor ka; pà nǝ anggeabyau ko amundi ma'wun sǝ wu kum mǝnia yì limurǝm ngga ɗàng.
Ən pa wun nzali mǝnana wu tanni ace raka, andǝ anggea-là mǝnana wun nǝ̀ ɓeǎ raka, sǝ wu do aɓalǝia. Wu lì aɓǝla-nggun mala aɓaban-anap andǝ amala aɓaban olif mǝnana wun nda wu pandǝ raka.>
Wu twal ɓwa mǝnana wun nǝ̀ kpate ka
<<Ado ka, wu ɓanggi Yahweh sǝ wu kpate nǝ ɓabum mwashat, sǝ aɓa mǝsǝcau. Wu sukki aɓakuli mǝnana aká-wun kpatea a nkaring Nggeasala Yiufǝretis, sǝ a Masar ka, sǝ wu kpata Yahweh.

Sǝ ɓǝ̀ kpata Yahweh ka, ɓealɓikea na a mǝsǝ wun ngga, wu twal yalung, ɓwa mǝnana wun nǝ̀ kpate ka, ko aɓakuli mǝnana aká-wun peri abania a bù-nzali mǝnana a nkaring Nggeasala Yiufǝretis ka, ko aɓakuli mala amǝ'Amor, nzali mǝnana wu ndanǝdo aɓalǝi ka. Sǝama mim sǝnǝ amǝ'ɓala mem ngga, sǝm nǝ̀ kpata Yahweh.>>
Pǝlǝa aɓwe ear ama <<Ɓǝ̀ sappi ban sǝm yi mana sǝm nǝ̀ ɗeki Yahweh, sǝ sǝm nǝ̀ kpata aɓea aɓakuli ka,

acemǝnana Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'sǝm nda mǝnana pusǝ sǝm, sǝnǝ aká-sǝm aɓa nzali Masar, aɓa ɓala mala doguro, sǝ yì nda mǝnana pakki amǝno yì agir-lǝmdǝa mǝgulke ka, a mǝsǝ sǝm. Yál sǝm arǝ anjar mǝnana kat sǝm wari kam ngga, sǝ aɓalǝ aɓwapǝndǝa mǝnana sǝm kùtí nǝbania ka.
Sǝ Yahweh pǝr aɓwapǝndǝa kat aɓadǝm sǝm, yì amǝ'Amor mǝnana à do a nzalinì ka. Acemani ka, sǝm nǝ̀ kpata Yahweh, acemǝnana yì ka nda Ɓakuli ma'sǝm.>>
Sǝ Jesǝwa banggi aɓwe ama, <<Wu pà wu nǝ̀ gandǝ kpata Yahweh ɗàng, acemǝnana yì ka Ɓakuli mǝfele na. Ɓakuli mǝ'mɓali na; pà nǝ̀ twala-wun-ban amgbicau ma'wun ko acauɓikea ma'wun ɗàng.
Ɓǝ̀ wu ɗeki Yahweh sǝ wu kpata abǝri aɓakuli ka, yì ka nǝ̀ pǝlǝa arǝ wun, nǝ̀ pàkka wun mǝɓane, sǝ nǝ̀ kiɗiki wun, kat andǝ amani ama ɗiɗyal ka, pàngŋǝ́nà wun mǝɓoarne ka.>>
Sǝ aɓwe eari Jesǝwa ama <<Awo, sǝm nǝ̀ kpata Yahweh.>>
Pǝlǝa Jesǝwa banggi aɓwe ama <<Wu nda ka amǝ'nakún arǝ ɓamurǝ wun ama wu twalna Yahweh, wun nǝ̀ kpate.>> Sǝ à ear ama, <<E, sǝm nda ka amǝ'nakún!>>
Jesǝwa na ama, <<Ado ka, wu vwakibu wun arǝ abǝri aɓakuli mǝnana aɓalǝ wun ngga, sǝ wu pà ɓabum wun aban Yahweh Ɓakuli mala Isǝrayila.>>
Sǝ aɓwe ne Jesǝwa ama, <<Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'sǝm na sǝm nǝ̀ kpate, sǝ gì na sǝm nǝ̀ oè ka.>>
Anggo sǝ Jesǝwa kùrcau nǝ aɓwe a pwari mǝno, sǝ tsǝkia wia anzongcau andǝ angguracau a Shekem.
Sǝ Jesǝwa gilǝ amǝnia yì acau ka aɓa Malǝmce Nggurcau mala Ɓakuli. Sǝ twal tali mǝgule, tamsǝi a tǝrta nggun mǝgule mǝnana nda tù nǝ ban Taragula mala Yahweh ka.

Sǝ Jesǝwa ne aɓwe kat ama, <<Wu sǝni, mǝnia yì tali ka, nǝ̀ duk girnakun arǝ sǝm, acemǝnana ongŋǝna acau mǝnana kat Yahweh bangga sǝm ngga. Acemani ka, nǝ̀ duk girnakun arǝ wun, ace mgbàllì wun arǝ tǝmce Ɓakuli ma'wun.>>
Pǝlǝa Jesǝwa mesǝ aɓwe ɓǝà o, koyan ngga a nzali liɓala male.
Jesǝwa andǝ Eleaza wǔ
Anzǝm amǝnia yì agir ka, Jesǝwa muna-ɓwabura mala Nun, guro mala Yahweh wǔ, lang bwalǝna pǝlǝa gbǝman-mwashat nǝ lum (110) ngga.
Sǝ à tsǝk luí a nzali liɓala male a Timnat-Sera, mǝnana nda a nzali múr-ankono mala Ifǝrem ngga, nǝ njar-nza mala Nkono Gash.

Amǝ Isǝrayila kpata Yahweh aɓa do-yilǝmu mala Jesǝwa kat, sǝ aɓalǝ anonggio kat mala aɓwana-mǝgule mǝnana à ueo nǝyilǝmu anzǝm lú mala Jesǝwa, sǝ à sǝlǝnace túró mǝnana kat Yahweh pè ace Isǝrayila ka.
Sǝ mala amú Yisǝfu mǝnana amǝ Isǝrayila pwania a Masar ka,
à tsǝia a Shekem, a ɓaban mǝnana Yakupu kúrô a bù amuna-burana mala Hamo, tár Shekem nǝ agbatali bolo-azǝrfa gbǝman-mwashat ka (100). Banì duk nzali liɓala mala amǝkà Yisǝfu.
Sǝ Eleaza muna-ɓwabura mala Haruna wǔ, sǝ à tsǝkbani a Gibiya, là mala muna-ɓwabura male Finehas, mǝnana à pe wi a nzali múr-ankono mala Ifǝrem ngga.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: 1Kpa 28:9; 2Kpa 15:2; Ezr 8:22; Isha 1:28; 65:11,12; Ir 17:13.
